sources.title: Piracy monthly report April 2025
sources.text: During a routine check onboard the ship underway, the duty crew discovered footprints on the deck. Subsequent inspection revealed that engine spares had been stolen. When the ship anchored, the coast guard conducted an investigation onboard.
